entries.summary: Core draw loader silently truncated fractional contest/ball values.
Core loader and generic quality gate accepted missing contests in a sequential history.
Signal-profile drift was detected as telemetry but did not influence bounded quality/context weighting.
Independent audit relied on production implementations for replay and lacked a separate decision oracle.
Prospective activation evidence had no canonical fail-closed path into future freeze agent configuration.
Audit/global-integrity reports could emit an empty material-deficiency list by construction instead of consulting a verified registry.
Signal freshness was hard-coded rather than derived from causal forecast horizon.
Expert-cap redistribution could oscillate or return a normalized expert above the configured cap when another valid expert carried zero mass; the independent oracle mirrored the defect.
Operational freeze paths could label an artifact frozen_before_result without comparing wall-clock time against the authoritative scheduled draw datetime.
Canonical full-process freeze could claim frozen_before_result after the official scheduled draw because the target schedule timestamp was resolved but not enforced before freeze authority creation.

Official dataset reconcile bound the network fetcher at function definition time, so runtime substitution/monkeypatch in the CLI path was ignored and tests could perform an unintended live CAIXA request.
Continuity rendering treated informational workspace metadata as mandatory and raised KeyError for otherwise valid construction/operation/science proof payloads.
Independent audit resolved evidence by stale absolute paths, so canonical migration to B2 could invalidate otherwise hash-identical immutable evidence.

Completed prospective attempts could remain isolated in per-epoch ledgers instead of being append-only reconciled into the canonical scientific ledger, weakening the all-attempts-counted terminal rule.
A completed and learned prospective epoch could leave Mega-Sena.xlsx at target-1, blocking the next canonical prospective target even though a verified through-target dataset existed.

The global 100% line/branch coverage authority still required 21 components after smart_operator.py and smart_canonical_history_advance.py became critical operational authority, allowing a formally green proof that omitted newly critical code.

A regression test still hard-coded Mega-Sena.xlsx to contest 3054 after the canonical result store was validly advanced through completed contest 3055, causing a false failure and risking future rollback of the canonical-history continuity contract.
An already-applied maintenance helper ended with _test.py and was accidentally collected by pytest, executing SystemExit during full regression before product tests could run.

Current activation/product-certification artifacts retained pre-B2 runtime_guard absolute paths after canonical migration. The non-renewable activation artifact was archived/retired and the valid BUILD product certification was regenerated under the B2 canonical runtime.

Terminal isolation audit found historical archive/runtime helper files that still contained the retired pre-B2 SMART-MEGA root while retaining executable/config extensions. They were unreferenced by active product/test/config authority and were retired into SMART_STATE_ARCHIVE as non-executable historical text with SHA-256 preservation.

Finalizer assumed WMCP control-plane roots were local to the remote canonical node. Corrected to explicit LOCAL, EXTERNAL and INCONSISTENT topology; construction remains independent while deployment stays fail-closed.
Product certification fingerprint omitted critical non-smart-prefixed execution sources, allowing regression freshness to miss changes outside smart_*.py/test_*.py.

Product certification did not fail closed when SMART_CANONICAL_ROOT.json drifted from the promoted SMART_AUDIT_JUNIT_CURRENT.xml. Added live canonical-regression binding to build and require_current_code verification.

A FROZEN current-engineering epoch could remain operational after loss of FULL_PROCESS_PROOF.json, while generic adjudication did not reconcile generation proof authority against the active epoch and ledger. Added fail-closed generation-proof enforcement plus explicit immutable recovery proof for the already-frozen 3057 epoch without changing prediction content.

require_current_code verification checked current code fingerprint and canonical JUnit binding but did not independently reject a JUnit older than the current code surface. Added fail-closed regression freshness recomputation to verification.

Engineering chain recertification proof used MISSION_PROVEN although SMART_MISSION_STATUS remained MISSION_ACTIVE with terminal_6of6_proven=false. Replaced the terminal token with an engineering-scoped status and explicitly bound the proof to the scientific mission boundary.

After the D024 false MISSION_PROVEN claim was corrected, finalizer and governance tests were hardened so engineering recertification cannot self-promote to scientific terminal authority and must mirror SMART_MISSION_STATUS fail-closed.

A D024 backup preserved test_smart_mission_status_governance.py under SMART_STATE_ARCHIVE, causing pytest import-file mismatch during full collection. Retired executable backups and excluded SMART_STATE_ARCHIVE from pytest recursion with regression guards.

Top-level historical engineering artifacts retained MISSION_PROVEN-like status tokens beyond the artifacts explicitly demoted by SMART_MISSION_STATUS.json, allowing naive consumers to misread non-terminal engineering evidence as scientific 6/6 authority. Canonical mission status now inventories every terminal-looking root artifact by exact hash and governance tests fail closed on any unclassified or stale claim.

SMART_MISSION_STATUS.json is the unique scientific terminal authority but lacked an intrinsic self-hash, while critical production consumers parsed it directly. Added a self-hashed mission-status contract with semantic and active-terminal-inventory validation, migrated all production readers and the single terminal writer to fail closed, and added tamper/transition/integration tests.

The self-hashed mission authority accepted any hash-bound terminal JSON whose status was MISSION_PROVEN without independently revalidating the scientific terminal proof contract. Terminal reads now fail closed unless the proof is self-hashed and causally binds the pre-result freeze, signal ledger/adjudication, exact 6/6, all guards, independent audit PASS, official corroboration, and anti-retroactive rule.

Sequential live verification could not validate the completed 3054 learning state after canonical-root migration because its immutable ledger event retained a retired absolute path. Added hash-bound canonical relocation for historical absolute evidence without rewriting the ledger.

A concurrent external workflow recreated the retired legacy project root while a regression was running, invalidating canonical-only state. The official regression runner now fails closed if the local canonical environment is invalid before execution or changes during execution, and Product Certification independently verifies physical absence of the declared-removed legacy alias on the authority host.

The current operator could adjudicate the active target, but the only scientific terminal executor remained hardcoded to contest 3054, so a future exact 6/6 on the active 3057 epoch had no generic governed path to MISSION_PROVEN. Added an active-epoch terminal executor facade, dynamic target-scoped evidence bindings, current-epoch preflight, generic canonical history advance, and an explicit operator terminal action.

The active-epoch terminal executor re-resolved the current generation authority after recording adjudication. Recovered generation proofs correctly reject post-adjudication predictive authorization, causing a deadlock before learning, independent audit and terminal promotion. The executor now validates the frozen authority once before result mutation and carries that immutable binding through all post-result stages without weakening the generation-proof guard.

Terminal evaluation used the global count of historical adjudications in the field that the semantic terminal contract requires to prove one unique adjudication for the current target. Split target adjudication uniqueness from total attempt accounting: adjudication_count now proves exactly one target adjudication while total_adjudication_count remains bound to independent audit pair_count for all-attempts accounting.

A terminal proof candidate was written as a top-level MISSION_PROVEN JSON before SMART_MISSION_STATUS validation; a failed promotion could leave an orphan terminal claim that made the active mission fail closed on subsequent reads. Active-epoch terminal proofs are now epoch-scoped, accepted only through explicit hash-bound mission authority, and ordinary promotion failures remove the candidate proof.

D033 preserved the validated freeze binding only in memory. After a crash or operator restart following adjudication, terminal execution attempted to re-authorize the pre-result recovery proof and correctly failed. Added a fail-closed post-adjudication recovery binding that derives only from the self-hashed active epoch, immutable causal freeze, bound unique adjudication, pre-draw temporal guard, and hash-bound cutoff/state evidence; no generation authority is reissued after the result is known.
Material supervisory skills executed completely; authority freshness is reported separately and remains fail-closed when stale.
